scope: Same-delegation Cloud and persistent device Wallet readback from Android task detail after client restart

implementation.shell: Agent task detail exposes an explicit read-only same-ID recovery action. A confirmed Cloud pre-dispatch terminal state exposes a separate explicit Wallet reservation release action.
implementation.broker: Before reconciliation, the Broker rebuilds the v2 native Wallet reservation digest from the authenticated Cloud record's owner, delegation, parent job, agent origin/name/version, currency, input hash, quote digest/version/time, child/parent caps and deadline, then compares it with the owner-scoped durable local Wallet row.
implementation.unknown: Missing or mismatched local reservation returns recovery-required/unknown without changing the hold or resubmitting the Cloud task.
implementation.billing: No provider call, dispatch, invoice, or payment is performed by this readback path.

results.pureJavaJUnit: AUTHORED_NOT_EXECUTED: A2ARecoveryBindingTest.java; no Java runtime or Gradle is available

notAccepted: Android Core JUnit execution, JDK/Gradle/SDK compilation and instrumentation
Production Cloud provider task reconciliation or billing
